description.value: Provence Marinaside is an award-winning French seafood restaurant and bar on Marinaside Crescent in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, situated steps from the False Creek seawall — one of the city's most popular cycling routes. The menu centres on Provençal-inspired dishes featuring local seafood, with both indoor and outdoor patio seating overlooking the marina. It offers group and private dining bookings and participates in seasonal dining events such as Dine Out Vancouver.
